description.value: Domino's Pizza is a well-known Canadian pizza chain franchise operating out of a retail unit on McMillan Road in Abbotsford. The store offers both delivery and carryout orders, making it a convenient calorie stop for cyclists passing through the area. A broad menu of pizzas, sides, and drinks is available.
